blocks.title: Posture you can review
blocks.body: 3D depth vision identifies anatomical landmarks, then maps forward head, shoulder and pelvic alignment, knee hyperextension and leg type — with manual correction when the clinician needs it.

blocks.title: Composition with segmental detail
blocks.body: Eight-electrode analysis reports nearly 40 values including muscle, protein, fat, BMI, BMR, WHR and left/right segments — with configurable reference ranges.

blocks.title: Neck and shoulder mobility
blocks.body: Voice prompts and automatic position recognition guide cervical lateral flexion and arm-elevation assessments. Gait and foot-pressure functions are intentionally on other products.

chapters.title: From measurement to a report you can hand over.

blocks.title: Guided capture
blocks.body: Create or select a profile, follow on-screen positions, and let the system recognize posture automatically. Thresholds can be configured for different facilities.

blocks.title: Share, print, integrate
blocks.body: Email the report, print it, add an institution logo, or upload through a data interface. Results support professional review and are not a substitute for medical diagnosis.

chapters.title: Keep gait and foot scanning on the right hardware.

blocks.title: OneScan for plantar pressure and gait
blocks.body: Five platform lengths, a high-density piezoresistive matrix, COP trajectory and temporal gait metrics — with open API and optional insole-data services.

blocks.title: F20 for 3D morphology of both feet
blocks.body: Synchronous dual-foot capture, 30+ measurements, arch classification and STL output for orthotics, footwear C2M and campus screening.
